Build.ProductionDeltaSinceBaseline: PowerShell renderer scratch reuse only. The Classic Pairs and ColorState ANSI encoders retain the baseline array-and-concatenate implementation; the slower StringBuilder attempt was measured and reverted.

Preflight.Limit: The launcher check verifies the catalog path only; catalog contents and audio playback are covered by their separate receipts.

RendererScratchReuse.MapSmoke: 36/36 Ultimate Doom maps; 35 idle tics and two 320x200 serial frames per map.
RendererScratchReuse.Differential: 36 E1M1-E1M9 views; 2,304,000 pixels; zero differences against the pre-change renderer.
RendererScratchReuse.Workers: Classic, Matrix/Katakana and AnsiArt/Katakana each match serial output at 16 workers across five headings.

RestoredArrayEncoders.PairsWorker: 320,000 pixels and 80 encoded strip checks across five views; zero differences with sixteen processes.
RestoredArrayEncoders.ColorStateWorker: 320,000 pixels and 80 encoded strip checks across five views; zero differences with sixteen processes.

MeasuredStringBuilderRegression.Result: Exact ANSI bytes, but 4.0-9.3x slower per strip and 83-103% more managed allocations than array-and-concatenate on the measured PowerShell thread.

CampaignSessionAudioChecks.SourceRelation: Gameplay, campaign/session, menu, input and audio source files are unchanged in this handoff build.
CampaignSessionAudioChecks.OrdinaryInputSession: 1,747 commands through E1M1 intermission into E1M2.
CampaignSessionAudioChecks.AudioWorker: 26 focused mixer checks, 9 music/effects checks, and 10 actual-device worker checks; submitted PCM matched an independent schedule and the device closed. One queue-timing stall was recorded.

HumanPlaythrough.MapSequence: E1M1 -> E1M2 -> E1M3 -> E1M9 -> E1M4 -> E1M5 -> E1M6 -> E1M7 -> E1M8 -> Episode 1 finale
HumanPlaythrough.Endpoint: E1TEXT / CREDIT finale screen after E1M8 exit/intermission.
HumanPlaythrough.EvidenceRule: Record only Jason-reported maps, E1M9 return, finale, deaths, reloads, deviations and defects.

KnownLimits: This qualifies readiness for one HMP Episode 1 human playthrough, not full Ultimate Doom release certification.
Most map completion is not qualified as ordinary-input completion; the user playthrough remains pending.
Displayed FPS and sustained 35-tic simulation pacing are not certified.
Full-campaign audio continuity and acoustic quality are not certified; the finite audio worker recorded one queue-timing stall.
The renderer remains an approximation rather than vanilla pixel/demo compatibility. Sixteen render workers previously used about 4 GB combined working memory.
Meaning: Readiness for one complete HMP human Episode 1 playthrough, not an Ultimate Doom release certification.
